# Tenant repository coverage

How much of the codebase still reaches tenant data outside the chokepoint
(`withTenantRepository`, `modules/db/server/db.context.ts`). Counted from the
source, not from a hand-kept list, because a list of 2 800 call sites goes stale
the first week nobody updates it.

Only calls on **tenant-scoped entities** are counted. A repository on `users`
or `tenant_databases` is cross-tenant by design and is not part of this move.

| | count |
|---|---|
| Tenant-scoped repository call sites | 1628 |
| Through the chokepoint | 1613 |
| **Still unscoped** | **0** |
| Reviewed exemptions (reason on file) | 15 |
| Modules migrated (gate enforced) | 103 |

Enforcement is not on: until the Faz 4 cutover the application-layer
`where: { tenantId }` guards are the isolation, and an unscoped call is a
migration debt rather than a live leak. What it WILL be on the cutover day is a
query that returns nothing.

## The gate

`npm run check:tenant-repo-coverage` fails when this file drifts from the
source, and when a module listed as migrated grows a new unscoped call. The
second half is the point: a rollout measured in months needs a ratchet, not a
finish line.

Migrated: `accounting`, `activity`, `ai`, `ai_agent`, `analytics`, `api_key`, `approval`, `asset`, `audit_log`, `auth_abac`, `auth_impersonation`, `bank`, `blog`, `bookings`, `calendar`, `comments`, `commerce_cart`, `commerce_catalog`, `commerce_fulfillment`, `commerce_order`, `commerce_return`, `commerce_review`, `commerce_shipping`, `commerce_wishlist`, `contact`, `contract`, `coupon`, `crm_assignment`, `crm_lead`, `crm_lead_finder`, `crm_opportunity`, `dashboard`, `data_import`, `document`, `drive`, `dynamic_page`, `enrichment`, `events`, `feature_flags`, `field_service`, `form_builder`, `fx`, `gift_card`, `hr`, `hr_contract`, `hr_leave`, `hr_payroll`, `hr_recruitment`, `hr_schedule`, `integrations_hub`, `inventory`, `invoice`, `legal_tr`, `loyalty`, `mail_inbound`, `manufacturing`, `marketing`, `marketplace`, `marketplace_developer`, `media_gallery`, `messaging`, `metering`, `navigation`, `notification_inapp`, `notification_log`, `notification_push`, `notification_sms`, `observability`, `organization`, `payment`, `payment_subscription`, `pipeline`, `plugin_runtime`, `pos`, `pricing`, `privacy`, `procurement`, `project`, `quote`, `redirect`, `scim`, `search`, `seo`, `storage`, `support`, `tags`, `tasks`, `tax`, `telephony`, `tenant`, `tenant_domain`, `tenant_export`, `tenant_invitation`, `tenant_member`, `tenant_setting`, `tenant_subscription`, `tenant_usage`, `terms_consent`, `time_entry`, `utm`, `wallet`, `warehouse`, `webhook`.
